{{Quote|Like so many of the people that we tell ourselves we're here to serve, Teckla lives in a district that rarely has electricity and running water as a result of the war. Her children can now only bathe every two weeks, and they have no light in which to read or study at night.|Padmé Amidala, addressing the Republic Senate|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
A '''family''' that held the surname Minnau included the siblings [[Rehtul Minnau]] and [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla Minnau]], along with Teckla's half-[[Gender/Legends|sister]] [[Nandi]].

==History==
A middle-class [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] family bearing the surname Minnau lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The eldest of the family in one generation was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rehtul Minnau]], who worked as a [[law clerk]] in Naboo's [[Capital/Legends|capital]]<ref name="Teckla DB" /> [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> His younger sister was [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla Minnau]], and she had a half-sister named [[Nandi]]. The two sisters had a strong friendship in their carefree [[Youngling/Legends|childhood]] and attended [[Unidentified private school|school]] in Theed, where they stayed in Rehtul's house.<ref name="Teckla DB" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], who [[Capture of Theed/Legends|attacked]] Theed. During the early [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of the attack, Teckla and Nandi fled amidst chaotic [[Ground warfare/Legends|street battles]] into the [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of Naboo alongside members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. They were separated, with Teckla evading the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] until she found shelter for the remainder of the invasion in a [[Unidentified Naboo village (marsh)|marsh village]]. Teckla and Nandi reunited at the [[Freedom Day]] celebrations following the Naboo's victory against the Trade Federation.<ref name="Teckla DB" />

Both sisters completed their education and became servants in the employ of<ref name="Teckla DB" /> the Naboo<ref name="NEC" /> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], staying on Naboo to help manage her [[Naberrie family/Legends|family's]] [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]] estate [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]]. A [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] after the invasion,<ref name="Teckla DB" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted<ref name="Teckla DB" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="NEC" /> As a result, Teckla joined Amidala's staff at the [[Naboo Embassy]] on<ref name="Teckla DB" /> the Republic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="NEC" /> separating her from Nandi again.

Teckla had children of her own who lived with her on Coruscant in a poor district with limited electricity and running water. Amidala made a speech to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] referencing their struggles in an effort to block an increase in [[Trooper/Legends|troop]] [[Currency/Legends|funding]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> Teckla was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Embo/Legends|Embo]] on the planet [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]]<ref name="Rise">{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}}</ref> in [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|605}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Teckla Minnau's family was first described in her [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on [[StarWars.com]], which was written by the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] member "[[Evan Burger|ShadowCultist]] in [[2008]].<ref name="PoP episode guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/pursuit-of-peace-episode-guide|text="Pursuit of Peace" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> The entry stated that after Amidala's death in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Teckla returned to Naboo and [[Marriage/Legends|married]] an [[Teckla Minnau's spouse|aspiring writer]].<ref name="Teckla DB" /> However, the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[The Rise of Clovis]]" portrayed Teckla's death during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Rise" /> This article follows the events portrayed in the series.
